title: [KEYLESS] TAP SIMULATOR SCRIPT
features:
**Tapping**
• **Auto Tap** 

**Egg Hatching**
• **Fast Auto Hatch** – sends the next hatch the instant the last one finishes, so there's zero downtime between opens
• **Max Per Open** – opens 8 at a time with the gamepass/boost, otherwise 3, otherwise 1
• **Skip Hatch Animation** – mutes the hatch cutscene so nothing slows you down
• **Best Egg Mode** – automatically picks the most expensive egg your income can keep up with, or choose any egg yourself
• **Rare Hatch Notifications** – alerts on Legendary and above

**Pets**
• **Auto Sell** – multi-select rarities, deleted server-side as they hatch so your storage never fills
 *-never touches locked, equipped or golden+ pets*
• **Auto Equip Best** – re-equips your strongest team after every hatch and rebirth
• **Auto Golden** – crafts 6 identical pets into a golden one (100% chance)

**Rebirth**
• **Auto Rebirth** – 2 modes:
 *-Amount** – waits for the button you pick (x1 → x1.22B, or Max), never wastes a rebirth on a smaller button*
 *-Interval** – uses the biggest affordable button every X seconds*
• Keeps coins aside for egg hatching so hatching never stalls

**Progression**
• **Auto Islands** – buys the next island right at its portal and travels to your best tap multiplier
• **Auto Skill Tree** – spends gems on the best-value node (Auto Clicker first)

**Auto Claim**
• Quests, pet index rewards, offline earnings, tap chests, Lucky Ducky, leaderboard rewards

**Misc**
• Anti-AFK
• Saves your settings automatically
• Show / hide keybind (default: Right Ctrl)
